hermeticity.method: I first built focus-only models from 100:4 and its two complete branch inventories, including the non-dominant mapping of ث و ر to ء ث ر. I then evaluated the context roots once in packet order and retained distinct causal, spatial, material, social, and epistemic changes without selecting a single winner.
hermeticity.limitations: This is a reconstructed one-call trace because the focus and all context were visible in the same sealed packet; it is not a blind staged discovery log. Branch images are activation material rather than automatic word-sense assignments, and every directional or analogical arrow identified below is the reader's inference rather than packet-supplied causality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَثَرْ (ث و ر → root_000210/B002) and نَقْعًا (ن ق ع → root_001544/B004), joined by the instrumental or causal بِهِۦ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The plural agents disturb material from a settled position and thereby make dust rise. The packet supplies stirring and raised dust; I supply the causal arrow from their motion through the referent of بِهِۦ to a visible plume.

discarded_or_unchanged: Literal bovine, dried-curd, fixed-name, zodiacal, surface-scum, and protective-bag branches did not produce a coherent changed reading of the focus construction.

Prepared food, slaughter, ugly abuse, and the experienced-water-hole proverb under the focus noun remained lexically available but did not integrate with the focus verb more strongly than retained models.
Counting, waiting-period, calendrical return, proper-name, kinship, bird, vessel, and plant branches in the context did not change the focus reading.
Sword-mark and marked-hoof images repeated the stronger residual-trace mechanism without adding a distinct causal or spatial function.
The literal bull branch could reinforce animal imagery, but it did not independently alter how أَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا works and was therefore left unchanged.

strongest_changes: 100:1 supplies the repeated-impact engine: audible running turns generic stirring into a sustained causal plume.
100:5 gives the plume an inverse geometry: dust disperses outward while the agents penetrate inward into a gathered center.
100:7 and 100:9 convert the non-dominant trace activation into witness and forensic guidance, allowing dust to conceal direct sight while revealing passage.
100:9-10 scale surface disturbance into exhumation and sifting: ground gives up covering matter, then inward content is precisely extracted.
100:11 makes concealment observer-relative: the plume can veil bodies without erasing their trace or blocking knowledge of inward reality.
summary.what_was_special: The focus pair is unusually generative because ث و ر supplies disturbance, emergence, confrontation, and a split ء ث ر trace/possession family, while ن ق ع holds dust beside settling water, quenching, sound, poison, and terrain. Context did not collapse these branches; it organized them into coexisting kinetic, optical, acoustic, evidentiary, appetitive, ecological, and disclosure mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The referent and exact function of بِهِۦ remain open; instrument, circumstance, consequence, and enabling envelope all remain possible.
The non-dominant ء ث ر mapping produces powerful trace and possession readings but is more form-distant than the dominant ث و ر disturbance model.
The acoustic, poison, sterile-spark, and terrain-assay readings are branch-anchored activations, not claims about the locally dominant lexical sense.
The human and material sequences may be analogically linked, causally linked, or simply juxtaposed; the packet does not state the direction.
The identity of the plural feminine agents is not fixed by the hermetic packet and was intentionally not imported from external commentary.
